name: Web Development
tagline: Build and ship websites and web apps.
description: HTML, CSS and JavaScript, then TypeScript, how HTTP and APIs work, databases on the back end, security for web apps, and the tools to ship.
outcome: You can build a responsive front end, call and design REST APIs, store data in SQL, and deploy a small full-stack app.

stages.title: The front end
stages.summary: Structure, style and behavior in the browser.
stages.milestone: A responsive, accessible page that fetches and shows data.

stages.title: How the web works
stages.summary: HTTP, REST APIs and web security.
stages.milestone: Design a REST API and explain the security of a login flow.

stages.title: The back end
stages.milestone: A deployed app with a database behind it.
